column1: # Gate ground truth — full sweep, captured 2026-09-04
# NOTE: the prior GATE-STATUS.tsv recorded the FRONTEND hash for both repos. This one does not.
# Method: every package.json script matching ^(check|verify): excluding :self-test, :emit and
# :baseline variants, run at its repo root, exit code recorded verbatim. Logs alongside.
# EXIT CONTRACT: 0 = rule checked and holds. 1 = real violation. 2 = INCONCLUSIVE (prerequisite absent) — NEVER a pass.
## PREREQUISITES CLEARED — 8 of the 9 backend INCONCLUSIVE gates now report a real verdict
# Measured 2026-09-04 against a local PostgreSQL 18 brought to 685/685 journal entries.
# Each gate reads its OWN variable; they do not share one. All eight exit 0.
# Nothing was silenced to achieve this: no ratchet, ceiling, baseline, allowlist or assertion
# was touched, and STREAMLINE_ALLOW_PARTIAL_GATES was never set (4 of these accept it as an
# escape hatch that would convert an unmeasured gate into a fake 0).
